# Vendored dependency

Commit: `ed0397fbf1e4d4f2bc11ab3070522c613667d359`

Version: 1.0.0. License: MIT, copyright 2025 TOMIKAWA Sotaro.

Acquired 2026-10-26. `src/*.ts`, `package.json` and `LICENSE` are copied unmodified. No upstream build/prepare scripts are executed. Node.js 22.23.3 can load the TypeScript sources directly with `--experimental-strip-types`. The upstream 28 sample tests passed locally; this establishes binary reader/writer behavior against samples, not Nikon camera compatibility or color accuracy.
